summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 25 条 X 动态、0 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 12 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Claude（官方账号）· Anthropic
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic's official account shipped three tweets explaining the new Projects experience. A project accumulates over time: every thread both writes to and draws from a shared memory, so Claude can remember that the release slipped to Friday, or who to ask before touching the billing service. The project library holds both the files you add and the ones Claude creates. The limits are stated plainly: threads run in the cloud so they survive your machine going offline, but they cannot yet reach local files, local too…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 官方昨天放出了 Claude 的新 Projects 体验，三条推把机制讲清楚了：project 是一个会随时间积累的容器，每一个 thread 既往共享记忆里写入、也从中读取，所以 Claude 能记住「发布日期挪到了周五」或者「动 billing 服务之前要先问谁」。project 的 library 同时保存你上传的文件和 Claude 自己生成的文件。技术边界也说得很直白：thread 跑在云端，电脑关机也能继续跑，但目前还够不到你本机的文件、工具和内网，本地支持「很快」会有。Pro 和 Max 上已有的 projects 保持原样继续用，会随 rollout 逐步升级。

featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code
featured.summaryEn: Boris Cherny from Anthropic's Claude Code team gave the most quotable line of the launch: Projects changed not just how he interacts with Claude, but how he codes. Concretely, he stopped managing sessions — he fires off thoughts as they come, Claude splits them into threads, and the project remembers how he works. He says it's now where a large share of his coding happens, and backed it with a screenshot of his actual prompts to the claude code CLI from the previous day. At 2,352 likes and 211 replies it was the m…
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 的 Boris Cherny 给出了这次 Projects 更新里最值得记住的一句自述：它改变的不只是他跟 Claude 交互的方式，而是他写代码的方式本身。具体变化是「他不再管理 session 了」——想法冒出来就直接扔进去，由 Claude 自己拆成不同 thread，而 project 记住他的工作习惯。他说现在自己大量的编码工作都在这里发生，并附了一张自己前一天实际发给 claude code cli 的 prompt 截图作为佐证。这条推 2352 赞、211 条回复，是这批 builder 内容里互动最集中的一条实操反馈。

items.title: Cat Wu · Anthropic Claude Code + Cowork
items.summaryEn: Cat Wu framed Projects as a jump in abstraction level: Claude now coordinates all your sessions, so she fires off a batch of tasks and moves on. Claude holds context on everything she's working on and can produce an aggregated status update on demand, backed by long-lived memory that evolves with use. She's been using it daily, and the rollout runs over the coming weeks. The notable shift: the agent moves from "one conversation, one task" to "a persistent coordinator managing a task pool" — a product shape worth s…
items.insightZh: Cat Wu 从「抽象层级」的角度解释了 Projects 为什么值得关注：在新体验里 Claude 会协调你所有的 session，于是她可以一次性丢出一批任务然后走开做别的事。Claude 手上握有她所有在做的事情的上下文，随时问随时能给一份汇总状态更新；同时它带有长期记忆，会随着使用不断演化。她强调自己每天都在用，并说这个功能会在接下来几周逐步放开。这个描述值得留意的点在于：它把 agent 从「一次对话一个任务」推向了「一个常驻协调者管理任务池」，对企业里想做多任务并行的团队是一个可参考的产品形态。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq supplied the architectural detail, the most implementation-relevant tweet of the launch: Projects brings the Claude Tag architecture to Claude Code. There's one agent per project that manages memory and spins off subagents for tasks. You can tell it to be proactive, or to run things on a schedule. His verdict: it feels a lot nicer than a pile of disconnected sessions. This effectively confirms Anthropic is converging on orchestrator-agent plus subagent execution, persistent memory, and scheduled triggers —…
items.insightZh: Thariq 补上了架构层的说明，也是这次发布里对工程实现最有信息量的一条：Projects 把 Claude Tag 的架构搬进了 Claude Code——每个 project 配一个 agent，由它负责管理记忆，并按任务分拆出子 agent 去执行。你还可以让它主动一点，或者按计划定时做事。他的结论很简单：这比一堆彼此割裂的 session 舒服得多。这条基本确认了 Anthropic 官方在往「主 agent 编排 + 子 agent 执行 + 常驻记忆 + 定时触发」这个方向收敛，与市面上多 agent 框架的主流设计是同一条路。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie offered the cleanest executive-level framing in this batch: agents already make up the majority of inference, and that will trend toward nearly all inference over the next year or two. His evidence is the pace at which use cases are landing — agents reading every code change to secure software, processing all data inside workflows, handling the bulk of recruiting and prospecting research, reviewing every event stream and log from every system, and running errands in our personal lives. He notes he pers…
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 给出了这批内容里最适合拿去做管理层叙事的一段判断：agent 已经占掉了推理用量的大头，而且未来一两年会迅速逼近「几乎全部推理」。他的论据是场景铺开的速度——agent 会去读所有代码变更来保障软件安全、在工作流里处理全部数据、承担招聘和客户挖掘里的绝大部分调研、审阅世界上每个系统的事件流和日志，以及在个人生活里替我们跑腿，还有上百种别的用途。他特别提到，仅过去一周自己就上线了好几条一个月前在技术上还不可能实现的新工作流。结论：世界上绝大多数 token 将由 7×24 在后台执行海量任务的 agent 消耗掉。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch put numbers behind the software-volume explosion: it took Vercel ten years to reach 1 billion deployments, then another 1.4 billion in the last ten months alone. He expects more software to be produced next year than in all of computing history. Much of it will be tiny, personal, even disposable — an HTML file with some JavaScript ("artifacts"), a report, a pricing calculator, a slide deck, scaling up to sophisticated apps, agents and platforms. Hence deployment speed as an obsession: de…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 用自家数据给「软件产量爆炸」做了量化背书：Vercel 花了十年做到 10 亿次部署，而最近仅 10 个月就又加了 14 亿次。他判断明年一年生产出的软件量，可能超过此前整个计算史的总和。这些新增里有很多会是微型的、个人的、甚至一次性的软件——带点 JavaScript 的 HTML 文件（即所谓 artifacts）、一份报告、一个定价计算器、一套幻灯片，一路延伸到复杂应用、agent 和平台。他们据此把部署速度当作核心执念：上传、分配域名、全球传播一个 artifact 的总时间已经压到 1 秒，而且这 1 秒里包含全球 CDN、防火墙、不可变部署、域名分配、可观测性和回滚。另外两条推补充了细节：为赶热修可以用 `vercel --turbo --prod` 调用最快的构建机器（这个点子来自用户在 X 上的建议），以及他对 Vercel 正在成为 Java 生态部署层的一句自嘲式定位。

items.title: Google Labs · Google
items.summaryEn: Google Labs announced a CC agent built for families, aimed at cutting the time spent on household logistics. The feature list is concrete: up to 5 members per CC agent; a shared "Your Day Ahead" morning brief email; auto-synced schedules and to-dos via a shared Google Calendar and Tasks; coordination inside Google Chat to offload tasks like weekly meal plans and school supply lists; delegated paperwork such as permission slips and forms completed under your direction; and memory that distinguishes what applies to…
items.insightZh: Google Labs 发布了面向家庭的 CC agent，目标是把家庭事务的协调成本压下去，多留点时间给人本身。能力清单很具体：一个 CC agent 最多可加 5 名成员；每天早上推送一封共享的「Your Day Ahead」简报邮件让全家对齐；日程和待办自动同步到共享的 Google Calendar 与 Tasks；在 Google Chat 里跟 CC 协作来卸载具体任务（比如做每周食谱、开学用品采购清单）；把文书工作（家长同意书、各类表格）委派给 CC 在你的指示下完成；并且它会区分「适用于所有人的信息」（家庭采购清单、常去的餐厅）和「只适用于某个人的信息」（饮食禁忌、所在时区）。目前限美国、18 岁以上，可加 waitlist 或升级已有 CC。

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App / AI Studio VP
items.summaryEn: Josh Woodward, VP across Google Labs, the Gemini App and AI Studio, posted two quote-retweets pointing the same direction: this product line's center of gravity is shifting toward everyday, high-frequency use. He endorsed the family CC agent, noting his own household uses it, and separately made a direct pitch — if you're not using Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM) on your phone yet, you're missing out — attached to a user story. The signal for anyone tracking Google's AI product cadence: a senior exec personally pushi…
items.insightZh: Google Labs、Gemini App 和 AI Studio 的 VP Josh Woodward 昨天两条转发都指向同一件事：Google 这条产品线的重心正在往「日常高频使用」上压。他为家庭版 CC 背书，说自家也在用；另一条则直接喊话——如果你还没在手机上用 Gemini Notebook（NotebookLM），那是真的错过了，并配了一个用户案例。对关注 Google AI 产品落地节奏的人来说，这两条的信号价值在于高管亲自下场推移动端和家庭场景，而不是企业侧。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj Kothari published the most complete "self-driving company" experiment log in this batch. Obsessed with the concept for over a year and unsatisfied with every product he tried, he built one himself with Claude in the loop: nosugarforkids.com, a catalog of only healthy kids' snacks (a category he says surprisingly didn't exist), with chat-based recommendations for school, lunches and snack boxes, plus a nutrient-based tier list. The autonomy is the point — a Claude agent wakes up once a day to check the catal…
items.insightZh: Nikunj Kothari 交出了这批内容里最完整的一个「自动驾驶公司」实验记录。他说自己痴迷 self-driving company 这个概念一年多，试了大量产品都没达标，于是干脆自己带着 Claude 造了一个：nosugarforkids.com，一个只收录健康儿童零食的目录（他称这个品类此前居然不存在），可以对话式获取上学、午餐、零食盒的推荐，并基于营养成分做了分级榜单。自动化部分才是重点——一个 Claude agent 每天醒来一次，依次完成：检查目录有无新品、剔除已下架产品、寻找能扩大触达的新内容选题、检查 dataforSEO 和 Google Search Console 的表现数据、撰写和编辑新文章、维持质量不产出垃圾内容，以及（新增的）主动联系媒体争取外链。结果是：在零外链、零社交存在的情况下，站点自然增长到每天约 6000 次曝光、60 次点击。他还提到站点配了完整的 MCP 和 WebMCP，方便别人把自己的 agent 指过去。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Of Garry Tan's three tweets, the technically substantive one is his note on Memorable: they found a way to optimize memory with embeddings instead of more tokens, which he calls a powerful new approach to memory. Worth flagging for any team building long-term memory architecture — the dominant approach still stuffs history into the context window, with cost rising linearly with conversation length. The other two are positional: a "be careful what you wish for" warning arguing this is exactly why alignment must tar…
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 昨天三条推里，最有技术含量的是对 Memorable 的点评：他们找到了用 embedding 而不是「堆更多 token」来优化记忆的办法，他认为这是做 agent 记忆的一条有力的新路径。这个点对任何在做长期记忆架构的团队都值得记一笔——当前主流做法仍是把历史塞进上下文窗口，成本随对话长度线性上升。另外两条偏立场表达：一条借某个案例强调「小心你许的愿」，认为这正是为什么对齐的目标必须是人类整体而不是任何其他目标；一条则是那句熟悉的「未来已经在这里了，我们只需要选择它并让它扩散得更快」。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · SPC 普通合伙人、Bevel Health 联合创始人
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal — former Dropbox CTO, now a general partner at SPC — took a clear position on alignment and safety: he calls the approach in the post he was amplifying the right way to solve it, and names Goodfire AI as the leading non-frontier-lab company working on it, describing the work as "generationally important." For anyone tracking the AI safety investment landscape, it's a marker worth noting: independent interpretability companies are picking up public endorsement from tier-one investors.
items.insightZh: 前 Dropbox CTO、现 SPC 普通合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 就对齐和安全这件事表了个明确态度：他认为这（指他转发的那条内容所代表的路径）才是解决对齐与安全的正确方式，并点名 Goodfire AI 是非前沿实验室阵营里在这条路上做得最领先的公司，用词是「具有代际重要性」。对关注 AI 安全投资版图的人来说，这是一条可以留意的方向标——可解释性方向的独立公司正在获得一线投资人的公开背书。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux of OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT teams floated a half-joking but directionally serious question: has anyone tried getting Astra and Fable to agree on the perfect styleguide, then hosting it somewhere with a web MCP? At 5,524 likes and over 1,800 replies it was the most widely circulated item in this batch. What makes it interesting is the combination of two live trends — negotiated output between multiple models, and exposing that output via MCP as a service other agents can consume. That's essentia…
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 和 ChatGPT 的 Thibault Sottiaux 抛了个半玩笑但方向很实的问题：有没有人试过让 Astra 和 Fable 就一份完美的 styleguide 达成一致，然后用 web MCP 把它托管到某个地方？这条拿到了 5524 赞和超过 1800 条回复，是这批内容里传播最广的一条。它有意思的地方在于把两件正在发生的事拼在了一起——多个模型之间的协商产出，以及用 MCP 把产出当作可被其他 agent 消费的服务挂出去。这基本就是「agent 可访问的共享规范层」的雏形。
